ModMetaData.name: Animal Cosmetic Genes
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Ordinary animals, not only sapient ones, can look different from one another: eye colour, coat tint, markings. Work in progress: nothing is playable yet.
Each look is an Animal Traits System trait, so the animals are drawn, weighted, restricted by species and inherited by the framework. A gene can give an animal one of these traits.
Interface in English.
Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Animal-Cosmetic-Genes
